entry_points.description: Primary public API for SCF calculations. SCF.scf dumps flags, builds the object, calls pyscf.scf.hf.kernel, stores mf.converged, mf.e_tot, mf.mo_energy, mf.mo_coeff, mf.mo_occ, and mf.cycles, then returns total energy.
entry_points.name: SCF.kernel / SCF.scf

entry_points.call_signature: kernel(mf, conv_tol=1e-10, conv_tol_grad=None, dump_chk=True, dm0=None, callback=None, conv_check=True, **kwargs) -> (converged, e_tot, mo_energy, mo_coeff, mo_occ)
entry_points.description: Generic molecular SCF loop. It builds the initial density, hcore, overlap, Veff, creates or reuses DIIS, then iterates get_fock, eig, get_occ, make_rdm1, get_veff, energy_tot, and convergence checks.
entry_points.name: pyscf.scf.hf.kernel

entry_points.call_signature: dft.RKS(mol, xc='LDA,VWN'), dft.UKS(mol, xc='LDA,VWN'), scf.RKS(mol, *args, **kwargs), scf.UKS(mol, *args, **kwargs)
entry_points.description: Molecular DFT entry classes. RKS inherits KohnShamDFT and hf.RHF; UKS inherits KohnShamDFT and uhf.UHF. scf.RKS and scf.UKS delegate to dft constructors.
entry_points.name: RKS / UKS constructors

entry_points.call_signature: get_fock(mf, h1e=None, s1e=None, vhf=None, dm=None, cycle=-1, diis=None, diis_start_cycle=None, level_shift_factor=None, damp_factor=None, fock_last=None)
entry_points.description: Builds hcore + Veff, applies early-cycle damping before DIIS starts, calls DIIS update when cycle >= diis_start_cycle, then applies level shift. UHF variant handles alpha and beta Fock matrices.
entry_points.name: SCF.get_fock

entry_points.call_signature: CDIIS.update(s, d, f, mf, h1e, vhf, f_prev=None); lib.diis.DIIS.update(x, xerr=None)
entry_points.description: CDIIS builds commutator error vectors SDF-FDS, optionally in an orthonormal basis. The low-level DIIS object stores vector/error subspaces in memory or HDF5, builds the DIIS B matrix, solves extrapolation by linear solve or eigenvalue filtering, and supports rollback and restore.
entry_points.name: DIIS update and extrapolation

entry_points.call_signature: ADIIS.update(s, d, f, mf, h1e, vhf, *args, **kwargs); EDIIS.update(s, d, f, mf, h1e, vhf, *args, **kwargs)
entry_points.description: Alternative DIIS-family accelerators. They store recent density and Fock matrices, then use scipy.optimize.minimize on ADIIS/EDIIS objective functions to form extrapolated Fock matrices.
entry_points.name: ADIIS / EDIIS update

entry_points.call_signature: get_veff(ks, mol=None, dm=None, dm_last=0, vhf_last=0, hermi=1)
entry_points.description: RKS/UKS Kohn-Sham Veff builder. It initializes grids, evaluates numerical XC and optional NLC terms, builds Coulomb and hybrid exchange contributions, uses incremental direct-SCF J/K when available, and tags Veff with ecoul, exc, vj, and vk.
entry_points.name: DFT effective-potential path

output_quantities.description: Boolean convergence status stored as mf.converged after mf.kernel(). All representative cases should converge.
Final total SCF energy in Hartree, returned by mf.kernel() and stored as mf.e_tot.
Final total SCF energy for UKS/open-shell cases, where the goal permits a slightly looser absolute delta.
Final orbital-gradient norm, computed from mf.get_grad(mf.mo_coeff, mf.mo_occ, mf.get_fock()). The default conv_tol_grad is sqrt(conv_tol) unless explicitly set.
Molecular orbital energies for occupied orbitals and the lowest 10 virtual orbitals, split by spin for UKS.
Final one-particle density matrix from mf.make_rdm1(); UKS returns alpha and beta density matrices.
Number of SCF iterations stored as mf.cycles. Easy regression cases should not require more than one additional cycle versus baseline.
End-to-end wall-clock time for mf.kernel(), the primary performance measurement.
Optional runner timing around DIIS update/extrapolate calls.
Optional runner timing around mf.get_fock calls.
Optional runner timing around generalized eigensolver calls in the SCF loop.

runtime_command_template: import json, time, numpy as np; from pyscf import gto, dft; p=json.loads(PARAMS_JSON); mol=gto.M(atom=p['atom'], unit=p.get('unit','Angstrom'), basis=p['basis'], charge=p['charge'], spin=p['spin'], verbose=0); mf=(dft.RKS(mol) if p['method']=='RKS' else dft.UKS(mol)); mf.xc=p['xc']; mf.init_guess=p['init_guess']; mf.grids.level=p['grids_level']; mf.conv_tol=p['conv_tol']; mf.max_cycle=p['max_cycle']; mf.diis_space=p['diis_space']; t=time.perf_counter(); e=mf.kernel(); dt=time.perf_counter()-t; print(json.dumps({'converged': bool(mf.converged), 'e_tot': float(e), 'scf_cycles': int(mf.cycles), 'scf_kernel_seconds': dt}))

suggested_cases.description: Small closed-shell square H4 RKS hybrid case stressing early-cycle stabilization.
Closed-shell stretched N2 RKS B3LYP case with difficult SCF convergence.
Open-shell bent NO2 radical UKS case covering spin-polarized DFT and GGA hybrid path.

threading_model.description: PySCF is Python orchestrating NumPy/SciPy plus C shared libraries built by CMake. Native libraries use BLAS and optional OpenMP; lib.num_threads() controls OpenMP after import. BLAS libraries may also spawn threads. The optimization campaign should pin single-thread execution before importing PySCF.
